units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 60a:4">Ab. Zar. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>נכרי אדנא וישראל אכ׳</he> the gentile attending to the barrel (emptying it) and the Israelite to the cask (receiving the wine).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 60a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>כ׳ מליא</he> (if the gentile carries) a cask which is brimful.

<cite ref="Shabbat 141a:16">Sabb. 141ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>לא ליצדד … כ׳ בארעא</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) one must not (on the Sabbath) bend sideways a cask which rests in the ground; a. e.—Pl. <he>כּוּבֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 33b:7">Ab. Zar. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>אנס הני כ׳ וכ׳</he> carried casks away from Pumbeditha by force.
B. Mets. 25ᵇ.—בי כ׳ the retailer’s wine shop.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 86a:6">B. Kam. 86ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 64b:8">B. Mets. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>מרקיד בי כ׳</he> he dances in the wine house.
<cite ref="Yoma 11a:4">Yoma 11ᵃ</cite> <he>חזוק אקרא דכ׳</he> a support for the Fort of Turrets (of M’ḥuza); [Ms. L. <he>ליוקרא דכ׳</he> for the weight of &c.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400.]—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 70b:10">Kidd. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>בי כ׳ דפומבדיתא</he> the fort of P.—[<cite ref="Megillah 6a:10">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>בי כ׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. <cite ref="K00915"><he>כסי</he></cite>, Ms. O. <he>מִכְסֵי</he>); <cite ref="Ketubot 112a:1">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>מִיכְסֵי</he>.]
